forbidden: reading or scoring holdout outcomes before N_target valid draws exist
changing rule, window, K, tie-break, metric, MWU or gate after freeze (new version required)
selecting among variants using holdout data
editing predictions/evaluation_policy.json or prediction_log.json from this module

gate.G1: one-sided 97.5% block-bootstrap lower bound of mean IC > 0
gate.G2: mean IC >= ic_floor (break-even IC = break_even_excess / kappa)
gate.after_fail: ABANDON challenger; no retuning on the holdout; a new rule needs a new version and new data
gate.after_pass: only then consider a separate paper-trade comparison against the production policy; production unchanged by this spec
gate.evaluation_window: first N_target valid draws with date >= holdout start; single look; no interim scoring

minimum_worthwhile_uplift.rationale: about 1.8x break-even excess; smaller uplift is not worth any production/paper-trade change

primary_metric.aggregation: mean over evaluated draws; one-sided 97.5% lower bound by circular block bootstrap
primary_metric.name: mean daily Spearman IC between score and per-number draw count (100 numbers/day)
primary_metric.why: full-ranking accuracy; highest statistical power for one draw/day

rule.H: sum of f over the 10 numbers sharing the same tens digit (head)
rule.L: sum of f over the 10 numbers sharing the same units digit (tail)
rule.f: count of number n over the 90 valid draws immediately before target date T (rows with date < T)
rule.formula: score[n] = z(H[n//10]) + z(L[n%10]) + z(f[n]); picks = top-2 by score
rule.invalid_rows: rows without exactly 27 values in 0..99 are ignored entirely (not history, not evaluated)
rule.z: per-day cross-sectional standardisation over 100 numbers, population sd; sd==0 -> zeros

secondary_metric.name: top-2 excess hits per pick = mean count of 2 picks - mean count over 100 numbers (same day)
secondary_metric.note: reported with CI; underpowered by design; used only for direction (G3) and for the paper-trade stage
